name: memory
description: Save a fact that is shown in future sessions. Two stores: target "user" is who the user is (name, role, preferences, style); target "memory" is your notes about the environment (conventions, tool quirks, paths). One fact goes to one store. Keep entries short. Skip task progress, one-off logs and anything already in the prompt. The snapshot in the prompt is frozen for this session; a write shows up in the next session, and in this one after a compaction. replace overwrites the whole entry; old_text only locates it. operations applies every change atomically, and the final text must fit the character budget.

action.description: add appends a fact, replace overwrites one whole entry, remove deletes one.

target.description: user: who the user is. memory: notes about the environment.

content.description: The fact to store. Required for add and replace.

old_text.description: Text that locates an existing entry for replace or remove. It is not stored; replace overwrites the whole entry.

new_text.description: The full replacement entry when action is replace.

operations.description: Several changes applied atomically against the final character budget. If any change is refused, none are saved.
